Extreme weather

Deep Freeze

In Austin, you have four years to prepare for the February 2021 freeze. When residents turn up the heat, how much of your fleet will still be running?

Play Deep Freeze↗ Your decisions ↓

Choose your difficulty before you start. It’s free to play in your browser.

Location
Austin, Texas
Starts in
2017
Your term
7 years

Your starting point

You take over the public utility in 2017. Gas, coal, nuclear and wind all supply the city, and the cold can cut output from all four at once.

In this scenario you know the freeze is coming. You can retrofit the plants you have or keep the money for construction and individual upgrades.

Learn how to play

Your decisions

  1. 01

    Choose which plants to winterize

    Check which plants already have winter protection before you spend money on the rest.

  2. 02

    Check supply on a cold day

    Look at which hours are short of power as heating demand rises. A backup plant that freezes too won't fill the gap.

  3. 03

    Leave cash for gas

    Winterizing a gas plant helps it keep running. You'll still have to buy its fuel when gas prices spike.

How much would you spend before the first cold snap?
